clue.text: Generous sun god's in the wrong, which is written

indicators.note: in places the sun god's name within the written wrong

parts.note: libel is a wrong done in writing, as opposed to spoken slander
Ra is the Egyptian sun god; the 's stands for 'is'

explanation.surface: Someone generous is apparently caught up in a written misdeed involving an Egyptian deity.
explanation.definitionFit: A liberal helping or giver is a generous one; open-handed is the shared sense.

clue.text: One's left limb quick, heading off

parts.note: a leg is a limb

indicators.note: heading off means the first letter of the word for quick is dropped

parts.note: pacy is British informal for fast

explanation.surface: Someone describes their remaining limb as quick, once its head is taken off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' removes P from PACY, leaving ACY.
explanation.definitionFit: A bequest is what someone has left behind to heirs after death.

clue.text: See 20
Copy felt bad, so told off

parts.note: a repro is a reproduction, a copy
ached means hurt, felt bad

explanation.surface: A copycat felt guilty and was scolded for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be reproached is to be rebuked or scolded, an idiom for told off.

clue.text: Filthy money held up by Poirot?

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means the held letters are read from the bottom
held means only the inner part of the detective's first name is kept, losing its ends

parts.note: Hercule Poirot is Agatha Christie's detective

explanation.surface: Ill-gotten cash is kept by the famous Belgian detective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held' keeps the middle of HERCULE, namely ERCUL; 'up' turns it round to make the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Filthy lucre is the stock idiom for money, especially dishonestly gained cash.

clue.text: Moving around top of plant, seek to attract plant tissue

indicators.note: around means the word for moving surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: moving in the emotional sense, touching, can mean sad

indicators.note: top of picks the first letter of plant

parts.note: to woo is to seek to attract a lover

explanation.surface: Something circles a plant's top while trying to lure it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Moving' means emotionally touching here, not travelling; 'plant' appears twice, the first giving its top letter, the second part of the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapwood is the soft outer layer of a tree's wood, a botanical tissue carrying sap.

clue.text: Small country mansion built around the centre of Kilmarnock

indicators.note: around means the rebuilt letters go round the central pair
built signals the letters of mansion are constructed into a new order
the centre of picks the middle letters of Kilmarnock

explanation.surface: A country house is erected round the heart of a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'built' makes SANMINO; Kilmarnock is a town in Ayrshire, Scotland, whose ten letters have a two-letter centre.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny republic enclosed within Italy, one of Europe's smallest states.

clue.text: One stops for the advertisement

definitions.meaning: a stopper, as for a bath or sink

explanation.definitionFit: A plug is both a bung that stops a hole and a piece of publicity.

clue.text: First love given drink in Iranian currency

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: in places the drink inside the currency

parts.note: the rial is the currency of Iran
gin is a drink

explanation.surface: A first romance is plied with liquor paid for in Persian money.
explanation.definitionFit: The original is the first version, from which copies are made.

clue.text: Maybe setter Richard who acts left poor quality writing

parts.note: a setter is a breed of dog, hence maybe
Richard Gere is an American actor

explanation.surface: A puzzle compiler and a film star have abandoned some feeble prose.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setter' wants to be the crossword compiler; here it is the gun dog.
explanation.definitionFit: Doggerel is crude, badly made verse, the classic term for poor writing.

clue.text: Get to take a breath, inspiring last of air

indicators.note: inspiring, literally breathing in, means the gasp takes the letter inside

parts.note: to gasp is to take a sudden breath

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of air

explanation.surface: Breathe in sharply, drawing in the end of the air.
explanation.definitionFit: To grasp something is to understand it, as in 'I get it'.

clue.text: See 12
Concentration of current from river in China

indicators.note: in places the river inside the old name for China

parts.note: Cathay is an old name for China
the Oder is a river in central Europe

explanation.surface: Electric current flows from a river somewhere in China.
explanation.definitionFit: A cathode ray is a focused beam of electrons, so electrical current concentrated.

clue.text: Is project I'm expanding so?

parts.note: a growing project eats up hours; also the word for hours wraps round I'M, as if enlarging it

explanation.walkthrough: A double reading: an expanding project takes up hours, and the four-letter word for hours, T-IM-E, holds I'M inside, devouring it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that eats up a lot of hours is described by this hyphenated adjective, a fixed idiom.

clue.text: Perhaps rectangular flier carries a lot about paper

indicators.note: carries means the bird's name holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: a teal is a duck, something that flies

indicators.note: about means the word for a lot goes round the paper

parts.note: a ton, informally, is a lot
rag is slang for a newspaper

explanation.surface: A bird carries a large bundle of newspaper about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' makes TRAGON, and 'carries' holds it plus A; 'Perhaps' marks rectangular as one example, since a tetragon is any four-angled figure.
explanation.definitionFit: Tetragonal means four-angled, and a rectangle is one example of a four-angled shape.

clue.text: Kind of desecration?

indicators.note: with the question mark, kind of desecration hints at a version made from desecration's letters

explanation.surface: Is there such a thing as a variety of sacrilege?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Kind of' reads like 'sort of'; 'Kind' is the definition and 'of' with the question mark signals an anagram of DESECRATION.
explanation.definitionFit: Being considerate means being thoughtful of others, a close synonym of kind.

clue.text: Account arrives into state

indicators.note: into means the abbreviation goes inside the word for state

parts.note: a nation is a state
arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrives

explanation.surface: A report comes in to the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A narration is a spoken or written account of events.

clue.text: Say, what could be missing after punch in the mouth? A drink!

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is to be spoken rather than spelt

parts.words: what could be missing after punch in the mouth
parts.note: a pair o' teeth, knocked out by a blow to the face

explanation.surface: After being punched in the face you might lose some teeth, and need a stiff drink.
explanation.walkthrough: Spoken quickly, 'a pair o' teeth' gives the French-derived word for a pre-dinner drink.
explanation.definitionFit: An aperitif is an alcoholic drink taken before a meal to stimulate the appetite.

clue.text: When out of order, bleating evident

indicators.note: out of order means the letters of bleating are not in their proper sequence

explanation.surface: A broken-down sheep's cry is plain to hear.
explanation.definitionFit: Tangible means able to be touched, hence real and evident.

clue.text: Quietly, the love hides evidence of sorrow, showing tough exterior

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

indicators.note: hides means the French phrase for love conceals the other piece

parts.note: l'amour is French for 'the love'
a tear shows sorrow

explanation.surface: A lover quietly conceals their sadness behind a hard shell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the love' is French, l'amour, a common crossword trick; P is the musical piano marking for soft.
explanation.definitionFit: Plate armour is metal plating worn as protection, a literal hard outer layer.

clue.text: Funny name for German actor

indicators.note: funny signals the letters are rearranged in an odd way

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a comic name to give a German performer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Funny' rearranges NAME FOR GERMAN, thirteen letters, into the American film actor's full name.
explanation.definitionFit: Morgan Freeman is an Oscar-winning American film star.

clue.text: Where rabbits mad about unlimited sex, he loved many beauties

parts.note: a warren is where rabbits live

indicators.note: about means the word for mad goes round the letter

parts.note: batty is informal for mad

indicators.note: unlimited removes the outer letters of sex, leaving the middle

explanation.surface: Rabbits go crazy for endless sex, and a lothario had many beautiful partners.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unlimited' strips SEX to E; 'about' puts BATTY round it. The actor was famed as a Hollywood womaniser.
explanation.definitionFit: Warren Beatty was a Hollywood star notorious for romancing many famous actresses.

clue.text: Passion for fashion

explanation.definitionFit: Rage is fury, and 'all the rage' means currently fashionable.

clue.text: Crown-wearer thus, filling rotten, requiring a compound present in toothpaste

indicators.note: filling means the monarch and thus go inside the word for rotten

parts.note: bad means rotten
a king wears a crown
so means thus

explanation.surface: Tooth decay talk: a crown, a rotten filling and something in the toothpaste.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crown' and 'filling' wear dental disguises to match the toothpaste: one is a monarch's headgear, the other means going inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Sodium bicarbonate, a chemical compound, is used as a mild abrasive in some toothpastes.

clue.text: Paul is smiling to show support

parts.note: Paul is the setter, who refers to himself as I
to beam is to smile broadly

explanation.surface: The setter is grinning to show encouragement.
explanation.definitionFit: This steel girder with an I-shaped cross-section is a structural support.

clue.text: Mass of wavy hair, so vital swimmer has head shaved

indicators.note: has head shaved means the first letter of the swimmer is removed

parts.note: a sperm cell swims and is vital to reproduction

explanation.surface: A crucial swimmer shaves its head, losing its curly locks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'has head shaved' takes S from SPERM.
explanation.definitionFit: A perm is a permanent wave, giving hair lasting curls.

clue.text: Drink expert bound with string

indicators.note: bound with means the string is wrapped round the expert

parts.note: twine is string
able means skilled, expert

explanation.surface: A specialist is tied up with cord.
explanation.definitionFit: Table wine is ordinary wine served with meals, an everyday drink.

clue.text: In backing European nation, few suggested African country

indicators.note: backing means the word in is read in reverse

parts.note: GER, a few letters suggesting Germany, its abbreviation

explanation.surface: Backing a European nation, few proposed an African state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In backing' gives NI; 'few suggested' says only a few letters of GERMANY are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Niger is a landlocked country in West Africa.

clue.text: See 19
Plan to absorb litres in skin pigment

indicators.note: to absorb means the word for plan takes the abbreviation inside

parts.note: to mean is to intend, to plan
taken as written

explanation.surface: A scheme soaks up litres in its dye.
explanation.definitionFit: Melanin is the dark pigment that colours human skin and hair.
